summaries.title: Core Trac and GitHub Team Spring Cleaning (Southern Hemisphere edition)
summaries.summary: The WordPress Core team has updated Trac Bug Gardener and Component Maintainer lists to remove inactive contributors and ensure GitHub/WordPress.org account connectivity. New GitHub teams for Gutenberg, Core Component Maintainers, and Core Bug Gardeners have been created to provide triage-level access for requesting code reviews and managing pull requests.

summaries.title: Presence API: What’s new
summaries.summary: The Presence API (v0.14.0) now supports all post types, including Site Editor content, and includes a network-wide aggregation system for multisite environments. A key technical optimization moves post locks into the presence table, preventing lock refreshes from invalidating persistent object cache keys for post queries.

summaries.title: What’s new in Gutenberg 24.1? (30 September)
summaries.summary: Gutenberg 24.1 introduces significant design tool consistency by adding background, color, and typography controls to numerous core blocks, including Accordion, Tabs, and Comments. Key technical updates include full `theme.json` support for text shadows, a new public API for viewport state positions, and the addition of CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup, and Switch form primitives.

summaries.title: Dev Chat Agenda – September 30, 2026
summaries.summary: The September 30, 2026, Dev Chat will focus on upcoming release discussions and the transition from live to live-streamed releases. Key technical updates include Gutenberg's migration to Vitest for JS unit and integration tests and a discussion on the Secrets API trajectory ahead of the 7.2 beta.
